profile.headline: Application Engineer at Chevron
profile.summary:
🔹 Software Engineer | Data Integration | Oil & Gas Innovation 🔹

With over a decade of experience in software engineering, I specialize in building innovative solutions that transform data into actionable insights. At Chevron, I’ve played a pivotal role in developing Prospect into a robust data product, enhancing exploration decisions globally. My expertise spans SQL, C#, Azure, Python, and API integrations, ensuring seamless data management and analytics for high-impact projects.

Previously, I led HR cloud integration, pioneered Workday enhancements, and contributed to digital transformation efforts that streamlined operations across Chevron. Before that, at Emerson and Kinder Morgan, I designed reporting applications, optimized inventory systems, and supported global oil and gas operations with cutting-edge technology.

Beyond technical expertise, I thrive in cross-functional collaboration—mentoring, leading agile teams, and fostering strong partnerships to drive success. Whether integrating subsurface data for drilling locations or optimizing enterprise workflows, I bring creativity, precision, and a passion for innovation.

Let’s connect—I’m always eager to explore new opportunities and collaborate on impactful projects in the energy and technology space!

projects.title: Bulk Inventory & Compliance System for Kinder Morgan Terminals
projects.description: Company: Kinder Morgan 🔹 Role: Software Engineer 🔹 Summary: Developed an advanced SQL Server Reporting application for oil and gas terminals, improving operational transparency and compliance with FERC regulations for pipeline contract bidding. Designed and maintained an inventory tracking system across 150 terminals, integrating Power BI, Visual Basic, and SQL Server to streamline data analytics and reporting processes.

projects.title: Prospect Data Product Development
projects.description: ompany: Chevron 🔹 Role: Software Engineer – Integration Developer 🔹 Summary: Transformed Prospect into a powerful data product, enabling real-time insights for advisors and Data Scientists in Subsurface. Developed secure and accessible data views, integrated API-generated data, and enhanced front-end and back-end functionality within the Explore Suite.
